validate_training_manifest: validate a JSONL training manifest file checking audio files, text content, and required columns
check_audio_file: check if an audio file exists and matches the expected sample rate
get_audio_duration: get the duration in seconds of an audio file using soundfile
print_validation_report: print a human-readable validation report with statistics and errors to stderr
create_validation_result: create a ValidationResult dataclass to hold total samples, errors, warnings, and audio duration statistics
